clip-1.prompt: Live-action, warm and quiet, for people who buy specialty coffee. Make one 10-second, 16:9 YouTube ad with natural photographic detail, restrained movement, and an unhurried rhythm. 0–3 s: A locked-off close-up shows a plain ceramic mug with a curved handle resting on a wooden table at dawn. The mug contains dark hot brewed coffee, with delicate steam clearly rising against the softly shaded background. Low, warm dawn light enters from the side, grazing the wood grain and illuminating the steam. Keep the surroundings indistinct, with no identifiable café, landscape, or building. Focus on the mug rim, steam, and tactile tabletop; the background stays softly blurred. Hear only faint morning room tone and a distant bird, gently mixed. 3–7 s: A single relaxed hand enters slowly from the right, curls its fingers naturally around the handle, and lifts the same mug smoothly clear of the table. Its shadow separates from the base as the mug rises; steam continues drifting upward. Keep the camera still and the motion physically natural. Hear a soft fingertip contact and a subtle ceramic release from the wood. No face appears. 7–10 s: Cut to a simple cream end card. Center the exact words 'Cabin Coffee' in medium dark-brown lettering above the exact words 'Wake up slow' in larger dark-brown lettering. Both appear immediately, comfortably inset, and remain perfectly still and legible for all three seconds through the final frame. Let the quiet room tone linger. No other text, no logos, no additional cuts, no music, no speech, and no subtitles.

brief: A 10-second YouTube ad for Cabin Coffee: a steaming mug on a wooden table at dawn, a hand lifts it, end on the words 'Wake up slow'. Warm and quiet, for people who buy specialty coffee.

queries: Cabin Coffee official website brand logo coffee packaging
Cabin Coffee official mug product photography
gate.why: The ad scene is invented, but the named Cabin Coffee brand requires verification of its identity and documented visual branding.

research.subject: Cabin Coffee 10-second ad research. Working identification: Cabin Coffee Company, the Iowa-founded roaster and café franchise. The name is ambiguous: a separate Cabin Coffee operates in Arizona, so confirm the advertiser before using these brand references.

looks.look: The official Plaid Mug is ceramic, patterned with plaid, and has a handle. The text does not specify its colors, capacity, dimensions, or logo placement; those details should not be invented as verified product attributes. Suitable for hot and cold drinks. ([cabincoffeecompany.com](https://cabincoffeecompany.com/product/plaid-mug/))

The official horizontal logo asset shows an irregular burgundy five-point star beside black, bold, condensed lettering stacked as CABIN / COFFEE CO. Use the supplied artwork as the visual reference rather than substituting a cabin illustration. ([cabincoffeecompany.com](https://cabincoffeecompany.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/CC_Star_Type-H.png))

looks.thing: Coffee packaging — optional reference, not required in the brief
looks.look: Official Colombian product photography shows an upright tan paper-style bag with a folded top and a cream rectangular front label. The label carries the burgundy star and black brand lettering, green SOUTH AMERICAN wording, a South America outline, and selection checkboxes. This documents the pictured package, not every current product package. ([cabincoffeecompany.com](https://cabincoffeecompany.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/FRC_columbian-600x600.png))

looks.thing: Real café setting — only if the scene is intended to depict a Cabin Coffee location
looks.look: The original Clear Lake location describes its décor as western/north woods. This supports that broad style, but does not establish that the brief's table is an actual table there or that the scene takes place in a literal cabin. ([cabincoffeecompany.com](https://cabincoffeecompany.com/location/clear-lake/?utm_source=openai))

Specified only by the supplied brief. No particular real table, room, building, or geographical location is identified. Wood species, finish, table age, surroundings, and exact dawn colors are not documented.
No real person is identified in the supplied brief. Age, skin tone, gender, clothing, jewelry, and other physical details are unspecified; there is no sourced likeness to reproduce.

The official menu documents fresh-brewed hot coffee, but does not establish the appearance of this particular serving. Milk, foam, latte art, and garnishes are not specified by the brief and should not be presented as documented details. ([cabincoffeefranchise.com](https://cabincoffeefranchise.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Cabin-Menu-Full.pdf?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: Brand identity needs confirmation: Cabin Coffee Company is distinct from the Cabin Coffee café whose official website gives a Glendale, Arizona address and says it has served North Phoenix since 2004. Do not mix their products, logos, or histories. ([cabincoffeecafe.com](https://www.cabincoffeecafe.com/?utm_source=openai))
facts.when: Official website consulted for this research.

facts.fact: Brad and Angie Barber opened the first Cabin Coffee Company in Clear Lake, Iowa, on December 6, 2002. Its origin is a community coffee shop, not an identified remote cabin or wilderness estate. ([cabincoffeefranchise.com](https://cabincoffeefranchise.com/about/?utm_source=openai))

The company's official location listings cover Georgia, Indiana, Iowa, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, Tennessee, and Wisconsin. The film should not imply a worldwide café network. ([cabincoffeecompany.com](https://cabincoffeecompany.com/?utm_source=openai))
facts.when: Official location listing consulted for this research.

facts.fact: Cabin Coffee Company says it roasts beans daily on-site and lets customers select beans and roast type. Its documented business includes roasting, not merely serving coffee sourced under another café's identity. ([cabincoffeecompany.com](https://cabincoffeecompany.com/about-us/?utm_source=openai))
facts.when: Official company description consulted for this research.

facts.fact: Fresh Brewed Coffee appears under HOT COFFEE on the official menu. A mug containing hot brewed coffee therefore fits an actual offering; the scene need not imply an espresso or milk-based drink. ([cabincoffeefranchise.com](https://cabincoffeefranchise.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Cabin-Menu-Full.pdf?utm_source=openai))
facts.when: Official menu file in the September 2025 upload directory.

facts.fact: The official shop documents a ceramic Plaid Mug with a handle, suitable for hot and cold drinks. Its description does not establish insulation performance, dishwasher safety, microwave safety, or a particular capacity; do not attribute those capabilities without further evidence. ([cabincoffeecompany.com](https://cabincoffeecompany.com/product/plaid-mug/))
facts.when: Official product description consulted for this research.

facts.fact: Documented brand wording includes Everything's Better at the Cabin and Just be happy and have fun. Wake up slow is supplied campaign copy in this brief, not an established slogan verified by these sources. ([cabincoffeecompany.com](https://cabincoffeecompany.com/?utm_source=openai))
facts.when: Official brand pages consulted for this research.

story.style: Live-action; a still close-up, warm dawn light, quiet natural sound, and a simple cream end card.
fact_use: Fact 1: The ad uses Cabin Coffee Company, without borrowing the Glendale café’s identity.
Fact 5: Fresh-brewed hot coffee is a documented menu offering.
Fact 6 and documented mug appearance: The Plaid Mug is ceramic, patterned with plaid, and has a handle.
Documented logo appearance: An irregular burgundy five-point star accompanies bold, condensed black lettering stacked as CABIN above COFFEE CO.
Fact 7: Wake up slow is campaign copy supplied by the brief, not a verified existing slogan.
story.story:
For the first three seconds, the camera holds close on the Plaid Mug on the wooden table in the kitchen. Dawn light enters through the window, warming the wooden table. Steam rises from hot brewed coffee in the Plaid Mug, curling above the ceramic rim. The Plaid Mug’s handle and plaid pattern remain visible. There is no music or speech.

Over the next four seconds, Mara’s hand enters beside the Plaid Mug. Mara’s hand closes around the Plaid Mug’s handle. A faint brush against ceramic is audible. The Plaid Mug lifts slowly from the wooden table, with steam still rising. The camera stays still as the Plaid Mug rises toward the upper edge of the frame.

For the final three seconds, the image cuts to a plain cream background. The Cabin Coffee Company logo appears: an irregular burgundy five-point star beside bold, condensed black lettering, CABIN above COFFEE CO. Beneath the Cabin Coffee Company logo, the final words appear: Wake up slow
story.title: Wake up slow
